_source: Pipistrel Velis Electro HB-SYQ, Markus's photo of 3 Jul 2025 (sources/velis-panel-notes.md): two rows of round instruments — ASI, EFIS, altimeter; Power / RPM, slip ball, vario / flight timer — and on the right the GPS map above the EPSI 570C. The Power / RPM and the vario / timer are round digital displays still to build (their cells are empty for now); the EPSI is today's page until it is redrawn as the real 570C.

layout._note: clear of the mission title, clock and KEYS at the top left

config._source: Markus, from HB-SYQ (2026-11-12): 0 at 12 o'clock, then 20 … 160 clockwise; no green, yellow or red — a thick white band ~47–52 and a narrow white arc ~47–80 (the placards: V_S0 46, V_S 53, V_FE+1 81). Spacing: the real dial looks wider in the middle — even spacing here, to check.
Markus (2026-11-12): three pointers and a dual pressure scale (hPa and in. Hg) — the C172's dial with a third pointer
